items.exampleEn: He didn't seem bothered by the cold wind at all.
items.exampleZh: 他看起來一點也不在意寒風。

items.exampleEn: The gaiety of the children's laughter filled the house.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們歡樂的笑聲充滿整間屋子。

items.exampleEn: Cheerfulness is one of her best qualities.
items.exampleZh: 開朗是她最好的特質之一。

items.exampleEn: "That's humbug," she said, laughing at the strange story.
items.exampleZh: 「胡說八道。」她笑著說，覺得那個故事很荒唐。

items.exampleEn: The exultant students threw their hats into the air after the ceremony.
items.exampleZh: 典禮結束後，欣喜若狂的學生們把帽子拋向空中。
items.glossZh: 欣喜若狂的；歡欣鼓舞的

items.exampleEn: The young writer seemed possessed by one idea for years.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕作家多年來似乎被一個念頭纏住了。
items.glossZh: 著了魔似的；被（念頭）纏住的

items.exampleEn: He unashamedly cried at the end of the film.
items.exampleZh: 電影結束時，他毫不掩飾地哭了。

items.sentenceEn: He worked on the puzzle like a man possessed until midnight.
items.sentenceZh: 他像著了魔似的玩拼圖，一直玩到半夜。

items.audioEn: I'm not bothered about the price; I just want a comfortable seat.
items.audioZh: 我不在意價格，我只想要一個舒服的座位。

items.sentenceEn: Her cheerfulness made even the long wait feel short.
items.sentenceZh: 她的開朗讓漫長的等待也感覺很短。

items.sentenceEn: The salesman's promises turned out to be pure humbug.
items.sentenceZh: 那個推銷員的承諾結果全是騙人的話。

items.stemEn: She was ____ when she heard that she had passed her driving test.
items.stemZh: 她得知自己通過駕照考試時欣喜若狂。

items.stemEn: She is ____ proud of her new song and plays it for everyone she meets.
items.stemZh: 她毫不掩飾地以新歌為傲，見到誰都放給他們聽。

items.passageEn: Every spring, our town holds a flower festival. This year, the gaiety in the streets was wonderful, with music, dancing and colorful costumes everywhere. My neighbor, who is known for his cheerfulness, led the parade and unashamedly danced in a giant flower hat. The local soccer team, still exultant after winning the cup the day before, joined in too. Some people said the forecast of rain was humbug, and they were right: the sun shone all day.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，我們鎮上都會舉辦花卉節。今年街上的歡樂氣氛好極了，到處都是音樂、舞蹈和繽紛的服裝。我那以開朗出名的鄰居帶領遊行隊伍，還毫不害臊地戴著一頂巨大的花帽跳舞。前一天剛贏得獎盃、仍然欣喜若狂的本地足球隊也加入了。有些人說會下雨的天氣預報是胡說，結果他們說對了：太陽照了一整天。

questions.questionZh: 鄰居在遊行中做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 婚禮上的歡樂讓大家都忘了外面在下雨。
referenceEn: The gaiety of the wedding made everyone forget the rain outside.
Because of the gaiety at the wedding, everyone forgot that it was raining outside.
rubricZh: 要用 gaiety 當名詞（例如 the gaiety of the wedding）
「讓大家忘了」可寫，例如 made everyone forget、everyone forgot 等

items.promptZh: 她看起來很煩惱，因為她找不到鑰匙了。
referenceEn: She looked bothered because she couldn't find her keys.
She seemed bothered because she could not find her keys.
rubricZh: bothered 當形容詞，接在 look、seem 等動詞後（例如 looked bothered 等）
「找不到」可寫，例如 couldn't find、had lost 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 looked、looks 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："欣喜若狂的球迷在球隊獲勝後，在街上又唱又跳。"；改後："她得知自己通過駕照考試時欣喜若狂。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："I'm not bothered if people think my clothes are old."；改後："I was quite bothered when my friend was late for our lunch."
